Ethan — attaching a short architecture sketch and notes on network segmentation, KMS integration points and audit logs. High level:
- We run inference in a tenant-isolated runtime; customer data paths can be limited to VPC peering or on-prem connectors.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys and BYOK workflows; we can surface key rotation metadata to your key management team.
- Audit logs: per-request tracing with token-level cost breakdown stored in your retention window; can push logs to your SIEM via S3 or syslog.

Attachments: Nebula_MVP_requirements.pdf
